title: A Steenrod square on Khovanov homology and a cup-i product
summary: Lipshitz-Sarkar defined a stable homotopy type refining Khovanov homology, producing cohomology operations $\text{Sq}^i$ on the Khovanov homology $Kh(L)$ of a link $L$. Later, Morán proposed a sequence of cup-i products on the $\mathbb{F}_2$-coefficient cochain complex of any augmented semi-simplicial object in the Burnside category. Applied to the Khovanov functor, he obtained another sequence of operations $\mathfrak{sq}^n$ on $Kh(L)$, where $\mathfrak{sq}^0$, $\mathfrak{sq}^1$ agree with the usual Steenrod squares.
